date_check: Left out on purpose: not 17 November news. Voyager 1 crosses one light-day on 18 Nov; 2027 Grammy nominations were announced 16 Nov; Haiti's Fanmi Lavalas decision came 13 Nov.
note: 56 stories, all verified in stories-verified.md (18 Nov 2026). Every story happened or was first reported on 17 Nov 2026. Claims are marked as claims. No unverified items used. The unverified 'dirty bomb' report is deliberately absent.

stories.deck: Ukrainian drones and missiles destroyed the main road arch on Tuesday. Russia hit back at bridges in Kyiv.
stories.headline: Kerch Bridge road arch brought down

stories.deck: US forces struck Qeshm Island and tankers near Hormuz as the Gulf war entered its ninth month.
stories.headline: US strikes hit Iran's Qeshm Island

stories.deck: A trilateral summit of Trump, Xi and Putin was set for Thursday 19 November in Shenzhen.
stories.headline: Trump-Xi-Putin summit set for Thursday

stories.deck: Iran fired drones at a US radar in Bahrain, Reuters said.
stories.headline: Iran drones target US radar in Bahrain

stories.deck: The US lost measles elimination status, PAHO said.
stories.headline: US loses measles-free status
